_note: Calibration frames for the evening and morning runs of deploy/robofast-sequencer@.service:
Every frame is dark (light false), so the sequencer never requests a lease: the enclosure stays
closed and the telescopes parked (docs/design.md 3.4). The process exits when they are done.
spectrograph: KiwiSpec calibrations through the KiwiSpec service (the enclosure config's spectrograph
entry), taken by spectrograph_telescope (default the first), as true dark frames. KiwiSpec is iodine
only (JDE 2026-10-31): no ThAr, no fiber flats -- the service refuses them. Biases and darks are legacy
specCalib's defaults (nbias 11, ndark 11 at 300 s; about 65 min with the 22 s readout). The rest of the
iodine calibration is observed at night as scheduled requests (requests.example.json): a rapidly
rotating B star through the iodine cell each night, and templates of each RV star with the cell out
(docs/kiwispec.md, Calibration). Slit flats only if the slit-flat LED works: set slit_flat_led true in
the KiwiSpec config, then add {"kind": "slitflat", "exptime": 1, "n": 11} (legacy specCalib).
